wb_pm25.name: World Bank — Daily City-Level PM2.5 Estimates 2018–2026 (Global PM2.5 Watch)
wb_pm25.description: Machine-learning estimates combining IQAir monitors, TROPOMI satellite data, ERA5 reanalysis, EDGAR emissions and geographic covariates.

hf_aq.name: Pakistan Air Quality & Weather (10 Cities) — Kaggle dataset mirrored on Hugging Face
hf_aq.description: Hourly pollutants and weather for 10 cities. Provenance is undocumented; variable names match the Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS model), so values are treated as modelled.

openmeteo_era5.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis)
openmeteo_era5.license: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo API data); ERA5 from Copernicus C3S
openmeteo_era5.description: ERA5 0.25° reanalysis daily aggregates, local day (Asia/Karachi), fetched once and stored locally.

coverage.license: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo API data); ERA5 from Copernicus C3S

exclusions.rule: place name shared/near-identical across different GeoNames IDs
exclusions.example: Sahiwal (31.97°N, 72.33°E), Sahiwal (30.67°N, 73.1°E), Bahawalnagar (30.0°N, 73.25°E), Arifwala, Alipur (Islamabad Capital Territory), Alipur (Punjab)

exclusions.rule: identical daily PM2.5 series shared by several places (same model grid cell)
exclusions.action: flagged (kept); inferential tests use one representative per series
exclusions.example: Zaida, Tordher, Swabi, Sukkur, Sinjhoro, Sarai Alamgir
Chuhar Jamali, Pir Jo Goth, Khairpur Mir's, Zahir Pir, Washuk

exclusions.rule: fixed annual mean + abrupt level shift
exclusions.example: Sukkur, Rohri, Rahim Yar Khan, Multan, Mirpur Khas

exclusions.rule: source-derived calendar/AQI columns dropped; calendar fields are recomputed from timestamp and AQI categories are not used
